name: SCOUT WRF Rain
description: Hourly rain (RAIN) over Chicago from SCOUT's WRF-Chem 4.5.1 forecast of 2025-07-06 00:00 UTC: 49 hourly steps, 2025-07-06 00:00 to 2025-07-08 00:00 UTC, on its 1 km Lambert conformal grid, cut to the 51 by 44 cells around SCOUT's Chicago road graph (latitude 41.59 to 42.07, longitude -88.02 to -87.46). One of the five variables of the SCOUT WRF group the scout.routing package reads; its global attribute timezone (America/Chicago) is the time zone the package reads a start time in. From SCOUT, https://github.com/urban-toolkit/scout, backend/models/routing/weather_data/RAIN.nc, used with the permission of SCOUT's authors.
